title: COP31 collapsed in Türkiye. The hosts’ fossil ties did not
description: The COP31 ended without a final agreement. The European Union, several small island states and other vulnerable countries said they could not accept a text that failed to mention oil, gas and coal. Önder Algedik was there and reports.

title: UN COP31 climate talks collapse without an overarching deal as nations deadlock over fossil fuel commitments
description: The 31st UN Climate Change Conference (COP31) in Antalya, Türkiye, collapsed Sunday without an overarching political agreement after nearly 200 nations failed to reach consensus on fossil fuel commitments.
